cd /workspace/task && cat > /workspace/task/write_answer.py <<EOF
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/task/output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
code = """Sub DeleteBlankRowsAboveCode()
    Dim codeRow As Long
    Dim i As Long

    ' Find the row containing "Code" in column A
    codeRow = 0
    For i = 1 To Cells(Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
        If Cells(i, 1).Value = "Code" Then
            codeRow = i
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i

    ' Delete blank rows above the Code row
    If codeRow > 1 Then
        For i = codeRow - 1 To 1 Step -1
            If Cells(i, 1).Value = "" Then
                Rows(i).Delete
            End If
        Next i
    End If
End Sub"""
ws['A1'] = code
wb.save('/workspace/task/output.xlsx')
print("done")
EOF
